Privacy Policy

Effective Date: 23 September 2026

DECIPHER INVESTMENT ADVISORS LLP (“Decipher Investments”, “Decipher”, “we”, “us” or “our”) respects your privacy and is committed to handling personal information responsibly and transparently.

This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, retain and otherwise process personal information when you:

  • visit https://www.decipherinvestments.com/;
  • submit an enquiry or other information through our website;
  • communicate with us by email or WhatsApp;
  • request information about investment opportunities or our services;
  • participate in discussions with us regarding investment interests or requirements; or
  • otherwise interact with Decipher in circumstances covered by this Policy.

This Policy should be read together with our Cookie & Tracking Policy and any additional privacy notice presented to you for a specific activity.

1. Who We Are

The entity responsible for the processing described in this Privacy Policy is:

DECIPHER INVESTMENT ADVISORS LLP

5TH FLOOR, 5002, HTC-2,
PANCHWATI SOCIETY,
YAMUNA NAGAR,
NEAR DUMBHAL BRTS BUS STOP,
Surat City, Surat,
Gujarat, India - 395002

Privacy and legal enquiries: connect@decipherinvestments.com

Decipher is established in India.

2. Scope of This Policy

This Privacy Policy applies to personal information processed through our website and through related business communications, including email and WhatsApp Business communications.

Our website does not currently provide user accounts or an online investor login portal.

This Policy does not govern the independent privacy practices of third-party websites, platforms or services that may be linked from our website.

3. Personal Information We Collect

Depending on how you interact with us, we may process the following categories of information.

A. Contact and identity information

This may include:

  • name;
  • email address;
  • telephone number;
  • city;
  • country; and
  • other contact information you choose to provide.

B. Professional and business information

This may include:

  • company or organisation name;
  • designation or professional role;
  • investor type; and
  • information concerning a company, founder, institution or investment-related enquiry.

C. Investment-related enquiry information

Information submitted through our website or communications may include:

  • indicative investment amount;
  • investment interests;
  • information contained in your enquiry or message; and
  • other information you voluntarily provide when discussing an opportunity or our services.

Where we discuss personalized investment requirements with you, information you communicate about your objectives, circumstances, investment preferences, risk considerations, portfolio or suitability may also be considered during those discussions, even where Decipher does not maintain a separate formal suitability profile containing that information.

D. Communications information

When you contact us, we may process:

  • email correspondence;
  • WhatsApp messages;
  • enquiries;
  • requests;
  • responses;
  • attachments you voluntarily provide; and
  • information necessary to manage the communication.

E. Website, device and analytics information

When you use our website, certain technical and usage information may be processed through website technologies and analytics tools.

This may include information relating to:

  • browser or device characteristics;
  • website interactions;
  • pages viewed;
  • session or analytics identifiers;
  • referral information; and
  • similar technical or usage information generated when you interact with the website.

We currently use Google Analytics 4 through Google Tag Manager for website analytics.

Where applicable law requires prior consent for analytics technologies, those technologies are not activated until the required consent has been obtained.

F. Information contained in free-text fields

If you submit information through a message or free-text field, we will process the information you choose to include.

Please avoid sending sensitive or unnecessary personal information unless it is specifically required for your interaction with us.

4. How We Collect Personal Information

We collect personal information primarily:

  • directly from you when you complete a website form;
  • directly from you during email, telephone or WhatsApp communications;
  • directly from you during business or investment-related discussions; and
  • automatically through website technologies such as Google Analytics, where those technologies are permitted to operate.

5. How We Use Personal Information

We may process personal information for the following purposes.

Responding to enquiries

We use contact, professional and enquiry information to:

  • respond to requests;
  • understand the nature of an enquiry;
  • communicate with prospective clients, investors, founders, companies and other business contacts; and
  • conduct discussions before a potential engagement.

Providing and administering our services

Where you engage with Decipher, we may use relevant information to:

  • administer the business relationship;
  • communicate about the services or opportunities you have requested;
  • understand your requirements;
  • arrange meetings and communications; and
  • manage ongoing interactions.

Requested investment and deal communications

Where you have specifically requested or opted in to receive investment or deal opportunities through WhatsApp, we may use your contact information to send those requested communications.

We do not use this permission as consent for unrelated marketing.

You may ask us to stop sending these communications at any time by messaging us through the same WhatsApp conversation or contacting connect@decipherinvestments.com.

Website operation and administration

We may process information necessary to:

  • operate and administer our website;
  • troubleshoot technical issues;
  • maintain website functionality; and
  • identify misuse or security-related issues.

Analytics and website improvement

Where permitted, we use Google Analytics to understand how visitors interact with our website and to evaluate and improve website performance and content.

Where consent is required, analytics remain disabled until you choose to allow them.

Legal and regulatory purposes

Where applicable, we may process information to:

  • comply with legal or regulatory obligations;
  • respond to lawful requests from authorities;
  • establish, exercise or defend legal claims; and
  • protect our legal rights and interests.

6. Lawful Bases Where EU or UK Data Protection Law Applies

Where the EU GDPR, UK GDPR or another law requiring a specified lawful basis applies to a particular processing activity, our working bases are as follows:

Purpose

Lawful basis

Responding to enquiries and taking steps before a potential engagement

Steps at your request before entering into a contract and/or legitimate interests, as appropriate

Providing and administering agreed services

Performance of a contract

Compliance with applicable legal or regulatory requirements

Legal obligation, where applicable

Website administration and security

Legitimate interests in operating and protecting our website and business

Google Analytics and other consent-dependent analytics

Consent

Requested WhatsApp investment or deal alerts

Consent or another valid permission mechanism applicable to the communication

Where we rely on legitimate interests, those interests generally involve operating our business, responding to genuine business enquiries, administering relationships and protecting our website and systems.

Where processing is based on consent, you may withdraw that consent as described in this Policy.

7. Cookies and Similar Technologies

Our website uses cookies and similar technologies.

Some technologies may be necessary for the operation and security of the Squarespace website.

We also use Google Analytics 4 through Google Tag Manager for analytics.

Where applicable law requires prior consent, including for covered users in jurisdictions applying such a requirement:

  • non-essential analytics are disabled by default;
  • analytics are activated only after the required permission is given;
  • you may reject non-essential technologies;
  • you may manage analytics preferences separately; and
  • you may later change or withdraw your choice.

You can manage your choices through the Cookie Preferences control available on our website.

For more information, please review our Cookie & Tracking Policy.

8. Who We Share Personal Information With

We disclose personal information only where relevant to the purposes described in this Policy.

Current service providers include:

Squarespace

We use Squarespace to operate and host our website and to support website functionality and form handling.

Google

We use Google services including:

  • Google Workspace for business email and related workplace services;
  • Gmail for communications;
  • Google Sheets for internal management of certain enquiry information;
  • Google Analytics 4 for website analytics; and
  • Google Tag Manager to manage website tags.

Meta / WhatsApp

We use WhatsApp Business and the Meta WhatsApp Cloud API for one-to-one communications and for investment or deal communications requested by recipients.

Authorities and legal disclosures

We may disclose information where required by applicable law, regulation, court order or another legally binding process.

We may also disclose information where reasonably necessary to establish, exercise or defend legal claims.

9. International Processing and Transfers

Decipher is established in India, while some of the technology providers we use operate infrastructure and services internationally.

As a result, personal information may be processed in countries other than the country in which you are located.

For Google and Squarespace services, we use the applicable data-processing terms made available by those providers.

Meta and WhatsApp services may also involve international processing under the applicable service and data-processing arrangements for those services.

Where a particular privacy law requires additional safeguards for an international transfer, the applicable transfer requirements must be assessed in light of the relevant processing, destination and legal framework.

10. How Long We Keep Personal Information

We do not intend to keep personal information indefinitely.

Website enquiries

Personal information received through website enquiries and stored in relevant systems, including Gmail, Google Sheets, Squarespace and duplicate internal records, is retained for 30 days and is then deleted from those systems under our current retention process.

WhatsApp communications

WhatsApp conversations covered by our current business process are retained for 30 days.

Analytics information

Analytics information is subject to the retention settings configured for Google Analytics and the operation of Google’s services. We review analytics retention in connection with our website measurement requirements.

Required legal records

If applicable law requires us to preserve a particular record for longer, or if information is reasonably required for an active legal claim or dispute, the relevant information may be retained for the required or necessary period.

Once information is no longer required under the applicable retention basis, it should be deleted or otherwise disposed of in accordance with our applicable processes.

11. Your Privacy Rights

Your rights depend on where you are located, the nature of our relationship with you and which privacy law applies.

Subject to applicable law, you may have rights to:

  • request access to personal information held about you;
  • obtain information about how your personal information is processed;
  • request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information;
  • request deletion of personal information;
  • object to or request restriction of certain processing;
  • receive certain personal information in a portable format;
  • withdraw consent where processing is based on consent;
  • object to certain direct marketing communications; and
  • complain to an applicable privacy or data-protection authority.

Not every right applies in every jurisdiction or circumstance.

To exercise a privacy right, contact:

connect@decipherinvestments.com

We may request information reasonably necessary to verify your identity and determine which rights apply to the request.

We will handle valid requests in accordance with applicable legal requirements.

12. Consent Withdrawal and Communication Preferences

Where we rely on your consent, you may withdraw it at any time.

Withdrawal does not affect processing that was lawful before your withdrawal.

Analytics

You may change your analytics choice through the Cookie Preferences control on our website.

Where analytics permission is withdrawn, our consent configuration is designed to prevent future consent-dependent analytics collection.

WhatsApp deal communications

You may ask us to stop requested investment or deal communications by:

  • replying or messaging us through the relevant WhatsApp conversation; or
  • emailing connect@decipherinvestments.com.

Your request will apply to future communications covered by that preference.

13. Children and Minors

Decipher’s services are intended only for individuals who are 18 years of age or older.

Our services are not intended for minors, and minors are not permitted to use Decipher’s investment or advisory services.

If you believe that a person under 18 has provided personal information to us, please contact connect@decipherinvestments.com so that we can review the matter and take appropriate action.

14. Security

We use third-party platforms including Squarespace, Google and Meta to process information as described in this Policy.

The protection of personal information depends on both the safeguards available through those providers and the way the relevant systems are configured and accessed.

No internet transmission, electronic communication or storage system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

You should therefore use appropriate care when sending confidential or sensitive information electronically.

15. Users Outside India

Our website is accessible internationally, but Decipher is established in India.

We do not currently maintain an office, branch or other establishment in the European Union, European Economic Area or United Kingdom, and we do not currently maintain an EU or UK data-protection representative.

At the effective date of this Policy, Decipher does not currently identify an active EU/EEA or UK user or enquiry base.

If you are located outside India, privacy laws in your jurisdiction may apply depending on the facts of your interaction with us.

Where such a law applies, the corresponding rights and obligations will be assessed under that law.

16. India Data Protection Framework

Decipher is established in India and is subject to applicable Indian laws governing its handling of personal information.

India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025 have a phased commencement schedule.

We will review and update our privacy practices and this Privacy Policy as additional substantive provisions become applicable to our processing activities.

Nothing in this Policy is intended to limit rights that become mandatory under applicable law.

17. Third-Party Websites and Services

Our website may contain links to websites or services operated by third parties.

A third party’s collection and use of personal information is governed by that third party’s own privacy practices and terms.

We encourage you to review the applicable privacy information before providing personal information to an external service.

18. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy when:

  • our processing activities change;
  • our website or technologies change;
  • we introduce or remove service providers;
  • applicable legal requirements change; or
  • an update is otherwise required to keep this Policy accurate.

The updated version will be published on our website with a revised effective or “last updated” date.

Where required by applicable law, we will provide additional notice or obtain a new choice or consent before implementing a materially different processing activity.

19. Contact Us

For questions, privacy requests, consent withdrawals or concerns regarding this Privacy Policy or our handling of personal information, contact:
